_doc: EXAMPLE per-edition event config. Copy to config/event.<edition>.json and edit. Everything community- and edition-specific lives here so the application code stays generic. Every value below is a placeholder. Keys starting with an underscore are documentation only. A missing file or a missing block is NOT fatal: the loader returns empty values and the affected feature shows its 'not configured' state.
_zohoSponsorCategoryIdsDoc: Optional (only if you push sponsors to Zoho Backstage). Sponsor-category NAME -> Backstage sponsorship_type id. Find each id in the Backstage admin (Manage > Sponsors > Sponsor Category, browser dev-tools Network tab).

edition._expectedAttendeesNote: Approximate attendee count, substituted wherever {{expectedAttendees}} appears in task descriptions, e-mails and forecasts.
edition._doc: code is the unique edition key and should match the Code of your active Events row. Exactly one edition should be active.

community.name: Demo Community
community._doc: Identity of the community running this edition. A different community changes this block (and the rest of the file), never the code.

dates._hotelStayDoc: The first and last night the hotel picker accepts. Leave both blank to derive them from the event dates.
dates._day1StartTimeLocalNote: Local wall time the event opens on day1; drives the top-bar countdown. Blank defaults to 09:00.
dates._doc: lockDate: the hotel and dinner forms go read-only on/after this date; an edit to an already-submitted booking in the days leading up to it raises an organizer action item. preDay is the master-class / setup day.

ticketSale._doc: Drives the site-wide top-bar ticket banner. Before opensAtLocal it shows 'Tickets on sale <date>'; at/after it shows 'Tickets are now on sale' (a link when ticketUrl is set) or hides when afterOpen=hide. opensAtLocal is local wall time in dates.timezone. Set enabled=false to turn the banner off.

masterClassTickets._doc: Which ticket class grants master-class (pre-day) access. twoDayClassIds is authoritative (ticket-class ids are stable, names can be edited); nameMarkers are the fallback, matched case- and space-insensitively as 'name contains marker'. Leave twoDayClassIds empty to match on names only.

formDeadlines._doc: Per-form 'respond by' dates. Drive the incomplete-form chaser e-mails.

auth._doc: PIN-by-email sign-in: PIN length, validity window in minutes, and the per-address request rate limit.

sharepoint._doc: Optional SharePoint Online document library for sponsor uploads, graphics and photos. Authentication is configured separately (app settings / Key Vault), never here. Leave siteUrl empty to disable the integration; task descriptions then fall back to {{uploadPortalUrl}}.
sharepoint._sponsorUploadNotifyDoc: Who is e-mailed when a sponsor uploads a file.

_sessionLengthsDoc: Session-length quick picks (label + minutes) offered on the organizer session forms and the public /Sessions filter. Any positive whole number of minutes up to sessionLengthMaxMinutes is accepted.
_sessionLevelsDoc: Audience levels (label + numeric code). Always sorted by the numeric code, never alphabetically.
_sessionRoomsDoc: The per-edition room registry. Room names should be identical across your call-for-speakers system, the hub and your event platform. Venue rooms carry floor + capacity (preDay marks the pre-day set; the same physical room may appear per day with a different capacity). Expo locations have capacity null and expo true. Validation against this list is warn-only.

volunteer._doc: extraAvailabilityDays = lead-up days outside the public event dates that volunteers can still mark availability for.

resources._doc: Drives the shared, read-only /Resources page. Each link needs a label + url; note and isDownload are optional. An empty block renders a friendly 'nothing here yet' state.
resources.intro: Everything you need on the day, in one place.

sections.title: At the venue
sections.description: Where to go and how to find your way around.

sections.title: Need help?
sections.description: Reach the organizers if something is missing or unclear.

postEvent._doc: Post-event thank-you content. picturesUrl blank = the photo paragraph is left out. linkedIn is the list a company is invited to tag; a blank url renders the name as plain text.

placeholders._doc: Shared text-substitution map: any key here replaces {{key}} in sponsor task descriptions and e-mail templates. Keys starting with an underscore are never substituted. Leave a key empty when your event has no equivalent and the marker simply disappears from the rendered text.
